import Mathlib.Data.Set.Finite
import Mathlib.Data.Set.Cardinal
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Finset

open Set

theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [Finite ι] {s : ι → Set α} (hs : Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint s)) :
  (⋃ i, s i).encard = ∑ᶠ (i : ι), (s i).encard := by
  have h_disjoint : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (s i) (s j) := by
    intro i j hne
    exact hs i j hne
  let s' : Fin ι → Set α := fun i => s (index i)
  let s'_fin : Finset ι → Set α := fun s => ⋃ i in s, s' i
  let s'_fin_encard : Finset ι → Cardinal := fun s => (⋃ i in s, s' i).encard
  let s'_fin_sum_encard : Finset ι → Cardinal := fun s => ∑ᶠ i in s, (s' i).encard
  have h_finset_disjoint : ∀ s₁ s₂, Disjoint (⋃ i in s₁, s' i) (⋃ i in s₂, s' i) :=
    fun s₁ s₂ => disjoint_union_of_disjoint_on_fun h_disjoint s₁ s₂
  have h_finset_encard_eq_sum : ∀ s : Finset ι, s'.encard s = ∑ᶠ i in s, (s' i).encard :=
    by
      intro s
      induction s with a s IH
      · simp [Finset.empty_encard, sum_empty]
      · simp only [Finset.encard_insert, Finset.sum_insert, encard_disjoint_union h_finset_disjoint]
        rw [IH]
        rfl
  have h_total_encard_eq_sum : (⋃ i, s i).encard = ∑ᶠ i, (s i).encard :=
    by
      rw [Finset.univ_encard, Finset.univ_sum]
      exact h_finset_encard_eq_sum _
  exact h_total_encard_eq_sum
